title: Multi-Site Builds
description: Multi-Site Builds is a generation ability in the Static Web Network Generators database. Builds many sites from one source tree in a single run. Each site gets a config; the builder renders all sites sharing components. It takes source tree and produces sites. Tunable parameters: per site config. Guarantee: a failing site never blocks the others.

fields.mechanism: Each site gets a config; the builder renders all sites sharing components.
fields.guarantees: a failing site never blocks the others

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Template Inheritance
description: Template Inheritance is a generation ability in the Static Web Network Generators database. Lets pages inherit layouts from base templates. Templates nest; child pages override blocks while keeping the rest. It takes templates and produces pages. Tunable parameters: nested. Guarantee: overrides never break the base.

fields.mechanism: Templates nest; child pages override blocks while keeping the rest.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Content Collections
description: Content Collections is a generation ability in the Static Web Network Generators database. Treats grouped content — posts, records — as queryable collections. Collections are declared with schemas; pages loop over them with filters. It takes content and produces collections. Tunable parameters: per type. Guarantee: collections always validate against schema.

fields.mechanism: Collections are declared with schemas; pages loop over them with filters.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Incremental Rebuilds
description: Incremental Rebuilds is a generation ability in the Static Web Network Generators database. Rebuilds only what changed since the last build. Content hashes are compared; unchanged pages are copied from cache. It takes changes and produces rebuilt pages. Tunable parameters: hash-based. Guarantee: rebuilds never miss a changed page.

fields.mechanism: Content hashes are compared; unchanged pages are copied from cache.
fields.guarantees: rebuilds never miss a changed page

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Link Checking
description: Link Checking is a generation ability in the Static Web Network Generators database. Checks every internal link across the whole network. The link graph is walked after each build; broken links fail the build. It takes pages and produces link report. Tunable parameters: per build. Guarantee: broken links never ship.

fields.mechanism: The link graph is walked after each build; broken links fail the build.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Sitemap Generation
description: Sitemap Generation is a generation ability in the Static Web Network Generators database. Generates sitemaps for every site automatically. Each site's pages become sitemap entries with lastmod from content dates. It takes pages and produces sitemaps. Tunable parameters: per site. Guarantee: sitemaps always match the built pages.

fields.mechanism: Each site's pages become sitemap entries with lastmod from content dates.
fields.guarantees: sitemaps always match the built pages

Assets are minified, hashed, and referenced by their hashed names. It takes assets and produces built assets. Tunable parameters: hashed. Guarantee: pages never reference unbuilt assets.

Each build gets a preview URL; diffs against production are shown. It takes builds and produces previews. Tunable parameters: per build. Guarantee: previews never affect production.

title: Atomic Deploys
description: Atomic Deploys is a generation ability in the Static Web Network Generators database. Deploys by swapping to the new build atomically. The new build uploads fully, then the pointer flips; visitors never see half a deploy. It takes builds and produces live site. Tunable parameters: atomic. Guarantee: deploys never serve mixed versions.

fields.mechanism: The new build uploads fully, then the pointer flips; visitors never see half a deploy.

title: Search Indexes
description: Search Indexes is a generation ability in the Static Web Network Generators database. Builds a client-side search index for every site. Pages are indexed at build time; the index ships as a compact JSON file. It takes pages and produces index.json. Tunable parameters: per site. Guarantee: the index always matches the pages.

fields.mechanism: Pages are indexed at build time; the index ships as a compact JSON file.
fields.guarantees: the index always matches the pages

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Feed Generation
description: Feed Generation is a generation ability in the Static Web Network Generators database. Generates RSS and Atom feeds per collection. Feeds list the newest items with full content and correct dates. It takes collections and produces feeds. Tunable parameters: per collection. Guarantee: feeds never include drafts.

fields.mechanism: Feeds list the newest items with full content and correct dates.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Multi-Language Sites
description: Multi-Language Sites is a generation ability in the Static Web Network Generators database. Builds each site in every configured language. Content files per language render to parallel page trees with language switchers. It takes locales and produces trees. Tunable parameters: per locale. Guarantee: untranslated pages always fall back visibly.

fields.mechanism: Content files per language render to parallel page trees with language switchers.
fields.guarantees: untranslated pages always fall back visibly

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Build Analytics
description: Build Analytics is a generation ability in the Static Web Network Generators database. Reports build times, page counts, and asset sizes per site. Each build emits metrics; trends show which sites are growing. It takes builds and produces metrics. Tunable parameters: per build. Guarantee: metrics never slow the build.

fields.mechanism: Each build emits metrics; trends show which sites are growing.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: One-Command Network
description: One-Command Network is a generation ability in the Static Web Network Generators database. Builds and deploys the entire network with one command. The command builds all sites, checks links, and deploys atomically. It takes network and produces live network. Tunable parameters: 1 command. Guarantee: partial failures always roll back.

fields.mechanism: The command builds all sites, checks links, and deploys atomically.
